styles.name: iOS 15
styles.description: The iOS 15-inspired colours from mib2-mapbuilder (made for VW), applied to the Audi files by entry name, with flat land colours. Not yet tried on the car.

styles.name: Quadro
styles.description: After map65's Quadro theme, a modern take on Mac OS 8–9 Platinum: white roads with hairline outlines on a platinum desk, lavender motorways, Stickies-yellow main roads and a focus-blue route; warm graphite at night. Not yet tried on the car.

styles.name: Carta
styles.description: After map65's Carta theme, an atlas and encyclopaedia look: ivory paper, ultramarine ink and antique gold, atlas-red motorways, gold main roads and height tints; a navy planetarium at night with gold place names. Not yet tried on the car.

styles.name: Folio
styles.description: After map65's Folio theme, Garamond-era print and Gray's Anatomy plates: ink on warm paper, arterial-red motorways, venous-blue main roads, an ink-black route and sepia relief; a radiograph at night, bone-white on blue-black film. Not yet tried on the car.
